Today is the date `nika:date` gives in the person's IANA zone, and the day's bounds are its two local midnights, each written with the offset in force at that midnight, so a daylight-saving change on the day moves the bound with it. Per source, in the feed's own order, keep at most `max_per_feed` items whose instant (the publication date, else the update date when the feed gives only that) lies in [today's midnight, tomorrow's midnight). `today_items` holds one entry per named source in their order, `{source, read, items: [{title, link, published, summary}]}`, an unread source with `read: false` and no items; `undated` counts the items with no readable date and `failed_sources` the sources not read. The component writes nothing and calls no model: the digest, its summary and its delivery belong to the parent, under the parent's own permits.
